commands: lssec -f /etc/security/user -s default -a loginretries -a maxulogs -a minupperalpha -a minloweralpha -a mindigit -a mindiff -a minage -a maxage -a minlen -a minspecialchar -a maxrepeats
blurb: This check measures the AIX account and password-policy attributes in /etc/security against the DISA STIG for IBM AIX 7.x: login retry and logging limits, password length, character-class mix, reuse distance, minimum/maximum age, and login delay. Any attribute weaker than its mandated value fails, because it is a documented hardening gap an auditor will flag and it applies to every account inheriting the default stanza. The check only reads these attributes; it never changes them.
